description: Compacting a list at the root that has lost its last moment some other way than in compact-roots, as gen found: sliced to nothing, which Zig compacts to an empty root, and the port refuses with EmptyLastMoment, before writing anything (finding 28). Then it's given an element appended in a callback that wrote nothing to it, which since 89da8e7 is a none slot marked full, a moment set to nothing, so both compact it. A version 1 list whose only element is truly empty, from inputs/v1-one-unwritten, is refused too. What the port writes is what Zig writes with the refused compactions left out.

write.bytes: a long value in the second moment

ops.note: a history sliced to nothing is still a list
the callback writes nothing to the element it's given
an element appended and never written is, since 89da8e7, a none slot marked full, which is a moment set to nothing, and it compacts as one
a version 1 list at the root whose only element was appended at 6b93af1 and never written, so it's truly empty
